title: Louisville Slugger 2026 Backyard Baseball Limited Edition Aluminum Power Atlas (-3) BBCOR Baseball Bat

comparisons.notes: Manufacturer store, exact model WBL4172; the 29 inch / 26 oz SKU WBL41720102629 is available at $349.95 with no sale price.

writeup: The Backyard Baseball limited edition of Louisville Slugger's 2026 Atlas Aluminum Power (-3) BBCOR bat, model WBL4172, is $99.99 new at Woot. Louisville Slugger's own store sells the same 29 inch, 26 oz bat for $349.95, so this is about $250 less for a high school and college legal BBCOR stick with a one-piece alloy barrel. Woot showed very limited stock, with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Exact 29 inch / 26 oz Aluminum Power variant, UPC 097512984638, SKU WBL41720102629, per verified checker.
